tasks.short: Inform businesses, groups, and agencies about programs.

steps.what: Inform governmental agencies about educational needs
State the available programs and program policies

outputs: filed copy of signed briefing note v1

tasks.design: Informing businesses, community groups, and governmental agencies about educational needs, available programs, and program policies stays with the administrator. A job sends the note from {EMAIL} only after that version is signed. The job does not speak for the centre.
tasks.previous_blocker: A mail-out could announce a program the administrator had not confirmed.
tasks.enabler_now: A signed note can be sent on the existing mail path.
tasks.still_hard: What a group or an agency should hear is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The administrator gives the briefing and signs the note.

ambition.what: Send the same signed briefing to a community group that asks this month.

tasks.altitude: The briefing stays. Sending the signed note shrinks.

evidence.claim: The manager digest says curriculum, people, and marketing stay manual, with drafting help only.

assumptions: The job does not brief anyone.
research_questions: How often a program changes after the note is signed.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining time on the briefing is the conversation itself, already the person's work.

incremental.description: Update the ratio table or the stored code list when it changes, and clear drafts the administrator rejects.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes every briefing is still given by the administrator. The high end assumes only the signed note is no longer sent by hand. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The childcare administrator spends the week with children, parents, and staff. Tables and filing a signed note move to a job. No model hires, evaluates, or scores a child or a staff member.
reach: Parents hear about a child from the administrator, not from a generated note.
Teachers receive only the schedule or the action the administrator signed.
skills_to_grow: Tell a headcount from a decision to hire or to change a program.
Reject a draft sentence that cites a code or a figure with no source row.
role.ambitious_version: A signed purchase or funding pack can go out the same week, and the administrator still authorizes it.

job.title: Education and Childcare Administrators, Preschool and Daycare
